manifest.name: Lead Generation From Website Visits
manifest.summary: Generate Leads/Opportunities from your website's traffic

behavioral_notes.observation: The module overrides ir.http._serve_page so that on every successful (200) page view by a PUBLIC/anonymous user it resolves the website.visitor and — only if that visitor has not already produced a lead (e.g. via website_form) — reads the GeoIP country/state, the request URL and the client remote_addr (IP), then calls crm.reveal.view._create_reveal_view to queue that IP for reveal. A 'rule_ids' cookie tracks rules already matched for this visitor to avoid re-queueing across page views. The whole block is wrapped in try/except ('we never want to crash a page view'), so reveal is best-effort and silent on failure. This passive IP-harvesting on page render is invisible to metadata: there is no HTTP route, it is a framework dispatch override.

Active rules are cached (ormcache _get_active_rules, invalidated on create/write/unlink of country_ids/regex_url/active) and indexed by GeoIP country code. _match_url filters candidate rules by country+state, optional website_id scope and a regex against the URL (empty regex = '.*' whole site, '/' = homepage). Each rule carries the company-criteria filter (industry_tag_ids reveal mapping, filter_on_size + company_size_min/max), the contact filter (contact_filter_type role|seniority, preferred/other roles, seniority, extra_contacts 1-5 enforced by a DB CHECK constraint) and the output shape (lead_for companies|people, lead_type lead|opportunity, team/user/tags/priority/suffix, sequence ordering). _create_reveal_view bulk-inserts one crm.reveal.view per matched rule via raw SQL with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING against a UNIQUE (reveal_rule_id, reveal_ip) index, so an IP is never queued twice for the same rule. No external call happens at this stage — it only records intent to reveal.

behavioral_notes.element: crm.reveal.rule._process_lead_generation cron (IP-to-company IAP reveal + lead creation)
behavioral_notes.observation: The scheduled _process_lead_generation cron drives the acquisition: it cleans old crm.reveal.view rows (_clean_reveal_views, >5 weeks not_found), unlinks views whose IP already produced a lead within reveal.lead_month_valid (default 6 months) so a company is not re-revealed, then loops in batches of DEFAULT_REVEAL_BATCH_LIMIT=25 distinct IPs. Each batch builds an IAP payload (_prepare_iap_payload/_get_rules_payload: an ips->rule-ids map plus per-rule criteria incl. industry reveal_ids and contact role/seniority) and POSTs to the EXTERNAL IAP reveal endpoint (reveal.endpoint, default https://iap-services.odoo.com, path /iap/clearbit/1/reveal) via iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc using the iap.account 'reveal' account_token. For each returned company (_create_lead_from_response) it creates a crm.lead and deletes that IP's reveal_view; not_found IPs are marked so they age out; a credit_error halts the loop and triggers a no-credit notice. autocommit commits each batch for resumability. Metadata cannot show this: the leads are materialized purely from an outbound HTTP round-trip, not an internal document flow.

Before creating a lead the cron dedups against the global reveal_id space: a search_count on crm.lead.reveal_id == result['clearbit_id'] skips any company already in CRM from any reveal/mine source, on top of the per-IP 6-month window, the (rule,IP) unique index and the visitor cookie. Lead vals are built by the shared crm.iap.lead.helpers.lead_vals_from_response (company + first-contact mapping) then stamped with reveal_ip, reveal_rule_id, referred='Website Visitor', and reveal_iap_credits=result['credit'] (credits consumed for that reveal); an optional rule suffix is appended to the lead name. Each created lead gets a message_post_with_source('iap_mail.enrich_company') note rendering the full company profile. The acquired crm.lead then enters the standard base-crm pipeline (scoring/stage/convert); reveal_* fields are added to crm.lead._merge_get_fields so they survive lead/opportunity merge.

behavioral_notes.element: external integration (gap #7) — IAP Reveal / Clearbit IP-to-company provider
behavioral_notes.observation: Single outbound integration: iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc POST to the Odoo IAP gateway (reveal.endpoint, default https://iap-services.odoo.com) path /iap/clearbit/1/reveal, sending the batch of website-visitor IPs plus per-rule criteria. Auth is the iap.account 'reveal' account_token brokered by the iap framework; no third-party SDK is imported and no raw api-key is stored in the module. This is the SOLE source of company identity behind anonymous traffic — without IAP credits/connectivity the module harvests IPs (crm.reveal.view) but produces no leads. Economics are pay-per-reveal: reveal_iap_credits is recorded per lead, and credit_error halts the batch and emails record creators via crm.iap.lead.helpers._notify_no_more_credit (rate-limited by the reveal.already_notified config flag).

it_architecture.application: website_crm_iap_reveal (Lead Generation from website visits — IAP Reveal add-on bridging website traffic and CRM)
logical_data_erm: crm.reveal.rule -> crm.reveal.view (one IP-queue row per matched rule)
crm.reveal.view -> crm.reveal.rule (many2one reveal_rule_id, unique on (reveal_rule_id, reveal_ip))
crm.lead -> crm.reveal.rule (many2one reveal_rule_id, one2many lead_ids back-link)
information_flows: depends: crm_iap_mine (crm.iap.lead.industry/role/seniority, lead_vals_from_response, _notify_no_more_credit), iap_crm (reveal_id dedup glue), iap_mail (enrich_company note + no-credit mail), website_crm (website.visitor, web-to-lead)
inbound: ir.http._serve_page on anonymous 200 page view -> GeoIP+IP -> crm.reveal.rule._match_url -> crm.reveal.view queued (cookie tracks matched rules)
outbound: crm.reveal.rule._process_lead_generation cron -> IAP reveal service (https://iap-services.odoo.com /iap/clearbit/1/reveal) authenticated by iap.account 'reveal' token, batches of 25 IPs
side-effect: reveal response -> crm.lead.create (lead/opportunity) + iap_mail.enrich_company log + reveal_view unlink + reveal_iap_credits stamped
side-effect: dedup -> skip if reveal_id already on a crm.lead, or IP produced a lead within 6 months, or (rule,IP) already queued
side-effect: credit_error from IAP -> halt batch + _notify_no_more_credit email to record creators
downstream: created crm.lead enters standard crm pipeline (scoring, stage progression, convert, won/lost)

capabilities: Identify Companies Behind Anonymous Website Traffic (IP-to-company reveal)
Define Website Lead-Generation Rules (country/state/URL, size, industry criteria)
Convert Web Visits into CRM Leads/Opportunities
Contact Discovery & Company Enrichment (role/seniority, enrich note)
IAP Credit Metering for Reveal & Deduplication of Acquired Companies
Feed Acquired Leads into the CRM Pipeline
value_streams: Anonymous visit -> GeoIP/URL rule match -> queue IP -> cron reveal -> create lead/opportunity -> enrich -> hand to CRM pipeline
Credit lifecycle: debit per reveal (reveal_iap_credits) -> credit_error halts batch -> notify creators
Dedup lifecycle: cookie + unique (rule,IP) index + 6-month IP window + global reveal_id check
policies: 4 access rules + 4 record rules scoping reveal rules/views; no module-specific groups (reuses crm/sales_team groups)
matching policy: GeoIP country+state whitelist, optional website scope, URL regex, sequence ordering of rules
guardrails: DEFAULT_REVEAL_BATCH_LIMIT=25 IPs/batch, extra_contacts CHECK 1-5, filter_on_size company-size bounds
dedup policy: unique (reveal_rule_id, reveal_ip) index, reveal.lead_month_valid (6 mo) IP re-reveal block, reveal_id global skip, 'rule_ids' cookie
retention policy: reveal.view_weeks_valid (5 wk) cleanup of not_found views
credit policy: pay-per-reveal on iap.account 'reveal'; credit_error halts and notifies (rate-limited via reveal.already_notified)
stakeholders: Anonymous Website Visitor / Prospect company (acquired lead)
Odoo IAP / Reveal (Clearbit / D&B) data provider (external)

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services (3.1 / 3.5.1 Generate / manage leads)
classification.rationale: website_crm_iap_reveal is best read as a value network (Stabell & Fjeldstad): its core function is mediation — it sits between two populations (anonymous website visitors on one side, the external IAP Reveal / Clearbit-D&B identity network on the other) and creates value by brokering an identity match between an IP address and a real company, then routing the result into CRM as a lead. The network logic is explicit in the code: passive IP harvesting on every page view (ir.http._serve_page), a queue of would-be matches (crm.reveal.view), batched calls into the shared external data network keyed by account_token, and mediation/dedup so the same company/IP is matched only once. Value scales with the reach and quality of the external network, not with any internal transformation. It is a primary activity because it directly produces the pipeline input (crm.lead) that downstream sale (chain) monetizes, mapping to APQC 3.0 Market and Sell (3.1/3.5 lead generation). Shop was considered (it is a CRM-adjacent acquisition add-on, like the parent crm value-shop) but rejected: this module does not run the iterative diagnose/qualify/nurture problem-solving loop itself — it hands the lead off to base crm for that; its own contribution is the network-mediated IP->company match. Support was also considered (auto_install=false bolt-on, no routes, a dispatch override) and rejected: the function is value-creating customer acquisition, not internal enablement.

standard_capabilities: identify the company behind anonymous website traffic via IAP Reveal (IP-to-company)
rule-based lead generation by GeoIP country/state, website, URL regex, company size and industry
company-only or company-and-contacts tracking filtered by role/seniority
automatic creation of leads or opportunities routed to a team/salesperson with tags/priority/suffix
company enrichment note on each acquired lead (iap_mail.enrich_company)
credit-metered reveal with no-credit email notification
multi-layer deduplication (cookie, unique IP/rule index, 6-month IP window, global reveal_id)
batched cron processing with old-view cleanup and retention windows
typical_fits: B2B sites wanting to turn unconverted anonymous traffic into pipeline
targeting specific markets via country/state + URL-section rules (e.g. /pricing visitors)
manager-defined rules feeding leads straight into standard crm scoring/conversion
enriching leads with company + key-contact data without manual research
common_gaps: dependence on Odoo IAP credits and connectivity — unusable air-gapped or without a funded reveal account
reveal coverage/accuracy varies (many IPs return not_found; residential/VPN traffic unidentifiable)
GeoIP must be configured for country/state matching to work at all
privacy/consent considerations of identifying visitors are left to the deployer
no UI to preview/estimate credit spend before the cron runs; batch limit 25 fixed in code
alternative / 3rd-party reveal providers require custom development
